messages:
Cass: Quick sync  running a short copy microtest for Hosted / Dedicated / Private page heroes next week. Goal: clearer CTAs, explicit routing, and a small webinar banner. Who can draft tight variants?
Ravi: Ill take tone variants. thinking 3 frames: Speed (time-to-value), Cost (cost/unit), Security (compliance). Run cross-product.
Dana: Product notes: Dedicated must say "reserved GPU pools" + a one-line SLA callout. Private needs KMS & audit logs. Hosted should highlight quick onboarding and curated models. Avoid vague claims.
Maya: Routing plan (HubSpot)  each CTA to its own list, webinar separate: 
```
hosted_form -> list: lp_hosted_trial_520123; lead_source=hero_clarity_test_520123
dedicated_form -> list: lp_dedicated_inquiry_520123; lead_source=hero_clarity_test_520123
private_form -> list: lp_private_sales_520123; lead_source=hero_clarity_test_520123
webinar -> list: webinar_hero_520123; lead_source=hero_clarity_test_520123_banner
```
Cass: CTA suggestions: Hosted = "Start free trial"; Dedicated = "Request capacity"; Private = "Talk to sales"; Webinar banner CTA = "Save my seat". Add CTA microcopy under buttons (privacy/trial).
Ravi: experiment plan: 3 themes x 3 pages x 2 tones = 18 variants. Run 72h even split, then reweight. utm_campaign=hero_clarity_may2026, utm_content=variant_{id}. KPIs: impressions, CTR, form submit rate, qualified leads, webinar join rate.
Dana: Dedicated qual fields: desired qps, monthly token estimate, preferred region. If token_estimate > 250M route to AE. Private form: security contact + compliance checklist.
OpsBot: Staging links created: https://rwd.test/track/host520, https://rwd.test/track/ded520, https://rwd.test/track/pvt520, webinar: https://rwd.test/track/wb520. Webhooks scheduled Thu 08:30 PT.
Maya: Copy checklist for drafts: 1) headline (<=9 words) 2) one-sentence subhead 3) primary CTA label 4) CTA microcopy 5) 1 feature chip (<=30 chars) 6) optional webinar banner line. Keep language concrete and testable.
Cass: Owners: Ravi (copy variants), Maya (routing & lists), Dana (product accuracy), OpsBot (tracking). Drafts by Tue EOD, staging Wed, launch Thu. Reconvene Thu 09:00 PT to review winners. :rocket:
